note_001.Title: Code For Sterile Corridor
note_001.Body: You can’t stay in this room. All remaining people are falling back to the Sterile Corridor. The door code is 4458. When you wake up from the anesthesia, come find us immediately.

note_002.Title: Backup Generator
note_002.Body: I’m going to power up the generator. I can’t find my Maintenance Key, it must be around here somewhere. In case anyone sees it please put it here, I will be back after finding some batteries.
